notes: New: Workflows. Design a team of agents on a canvas and build with it. Each card is an agent with a role (orchestrator, architect, UI, backend, tester, debugger, reviewer, or one of your forged agents), a brain (Claude Fable 5, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Codex, Gemini, Grok and more) and its part in plain words. Wire cards together: several outputs run side by side, and a tester's ✕ Fail sends what failed back to whoever fixes it until it passes. Press Workflow in the toolbar (or Ctrl+Shift+O), type or say what to build, choose once, until it passes, or a number of rounds, and watch the team light up as it works in your project. Also: agents opened in a new folder no longer quit on Claude Code's trust question; LATYS waits for your answer.
